items.title: Google Is Getting Paid in Marvell Stock Warrants for Buying Marvell's Chips
items.summary: The search giant lined up another custom silicon partner this summer. It also negotiated something a purchase order never includes: the right to buy its supplier's stock at a fixed price.

items.title: Marvell Technology (MRVL) Stock Fair Value Edges Higher After Google AI Partnership Expansion
items.summary: Marvell Technology’s modeled fair value has shifted to US$259.66 from US$254.41, signaling an updated price target in the latest round of research. Analysts are linking this change to the expanded Google partnership, custom AI silicon exposure and growing focus on optical interconnect, while others point to concentration risk and elevated expectations as counterweights.
